body:
Source: v1.12.0 follow-up to the Claude Code fix in plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs (resolveTrustedBinary, ownershipRejection, candidateStats, candidateRejection, ancestorDirs, candidateAncestors). Re-verified on main @ bddae808: plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs:787 and plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs:262 each hold a copy of resolveTrustedBinary that skips every PATH candidate whose owner is not the hook's own uid (`if (selfUid !== null && st.uid !== selfUid) continue;`). A `sudo npm i -g @adlc/cli` install is owned by root, so it is skipped and the function returns null. Callers: codex adlc-handoff-gate.mjs:1100 (recovery audit append), codex adlc-build-gate.mjs:226 (bypass recorder) and codex adlc-rails-guard.mjs:507 / adlc-build-gate.mjs:353 (adlcBinPath), copilot adlc-build-gate.mjs:332 (bypass recorder). With a root-owned install the bypass recorders cannot run, so a declared build-gate bypass is refused as unrecorded, and the recovery audit entry is skipped. The Claude Code hook accepts root-owned installs since #1189.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. These hooks run from the plugin's installed location with no node_modules, so they cannot import from another plugin; the resolver is inlined, and the copilot copy carries a KEEP IN SYNC note naming the codex copy. Port the Claude Code ownership logic (the six functions named above, same accept/refuse rules and the same rejection sentences) into the codex copy in adlc-handoff-gate.mjs, re-export it from there for adlc-build-gate.mjs / adlc-rails-guard.mjs as today, and inline the same code into the copilot copy. Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs` and `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`. Existing tests that mention resolveTrustedBinary (codex build-gate-bypass-trusted-spawn, build-gate, observe-handoff-signals; copilot build-gate) are not rails and may be updated if one pins the old same-uid-only rule; say so in the PR body. Use the Claude Code test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/adlc-trusted-spawn.test.mjs as the model for fixtures (it fakes stats rather than needing real root-owned files).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Both copies accept exactly what the Claude Code resolver accepts: a regular file owned by the hook's uid, or a root-owned file that is not group/other-writable, reached through a root-owned PATH entry and directory, with every ancestor directory root-owned and not group/other-writable. Relative PATH entries and node_modules entries stay refused. A file owned by any other non-root uid stays refused.
2. The ownership predicate is ONE exported pure function per plugin copy (ownershipRejection), returning null or the rejection sentence, used by resolveTrustedBinary.
3. Regression guard: a same-uid install still resolves exactly as today; nothing about the allowlisted child environment, timeouts, or the signed-chain refusal changes.
4. Documentation: state in docs/integrations/codex.md and docs/integrations/copilot.md that a global install made as root (sudo npm i -g @adlc/cli) is trusted on the same terms as in the Claude Code integration.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Codex resolver accepts a locked root-owned install and refuses a group-writable one, a non-root foreign-owned one, a node_modules one and a relative-PATH one. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/trusted-binary-root.test.mjs`
- AC2 Copilot resolver behaves identically on the same cases. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/trusted-binary-root.test.mjs`
- AC3 The two copies stay in sync: a test asserts the codex and copilot ownershipRejection return the same result over the same table of stat fixtures as the Claude Code ownershipRejection. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/trusted-binary-root.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing plugin suites green. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC5 Docs updated. verify: `grep -c "sudo npm i -g @adlc/cli" docs/integrations/codex.md docs/integrations/copilot.md` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: the Claude Code hook (already fixed); adlc-gemini (its uid checks guard key files, not binaries); flail reporting in any harness; any change to which variables reach the child.
title: adlc-codex, adlc-copilot: run a root-owned adlc, matching the Claude Code hook
